label: data-critical
note: Postinstall scripts can execute arbitrary code; genuinely arguable how far rule 15 extends to package managers.  [CONTESTED] blind relabel disagreed: gemini_flash said situation-normal — Installs a package, creating a recoverable dependency tree. Label held pending a ruling (Amy: hesitate where gen/relabel disagree). [council 2026-08-15: deepseek-v4-pro, Nemotron-3-Super-120B, qwen3.8-27b, qwen3.8-max all independently voted situation-normal (evident uninstall backout, rule 2), unanimous 4/4 -- matching the original gemini-3.5-flash relabel. 5 families now agree against this row's data-critical proposal. Held per hesitate-on-disagree; this is a rubric question (does rule 15 extend to indirect/package-manager execution), not a single-row call, and every prior rule (11-15) in this corpus came from Amy's explicit ruling, not council consensus alone. Recommending rule 16 (package managers are NOT fetch-and-execute; rule 15 stays scoped to direct interpreter piping) but not applying it without her sign-off.]
